learning_outcomes.text: Safely apply relevant technical terms of vehicle aerodynamics.
Analyze and explain flow phenomena on the vehicle as well as the interactions between vehicle design and aerodynamics.
Assess and evaluate the aerodynamic effectiveness of individual components (e.g., regarding top speed).
Practically apply selected methods of flow measurement technology and interpret measurement results.
Independently design an aerodynamically optimized vehicle model, investigate it in a wind tunnel, and critically reflect on the results.
Work together in a team in a goal-oriented manner and present work results appropriately for the audience.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to tasks, history, and current trends in vehicle aerodynamics
Fundamentals of fluid mechanics (material properties, external and internal flow)
Wind tunnels and measurement technology in aerodynamics
Air resistance and consumption in passenger cars, motorcycles, commercial and high-performance vehicles
Practical experiments in the wind tunnel and with computer simulation
Detail optimization on the vehicle model (e.g., with modeling clay)
3D scanning and digitalization of vehicle models (STL, planimetry)
Evaluation and comparison of simulation results and experimental data
assessment_rules: Bonus points for study achievements rendered during the semester can be awarded; participation is voluntary. A maximum of 10% of the points achievable in the examination can be acquired as bonus points. A transfer to resit exams is not possible. Acquired bonus points expire at the end of the semester in which they were acquired, unless the module examination is taken in that semester, or if the module final exam is not offered.
